"""Comparison-only SUB-26 sound surfaces; never a transcript or edit authority.

Only conventional repeated laughter and standalone hesitation sounds are
handled. Foreign words, interjections with possible meaning, lexical fragments
and arbitrary unrecognized script remain untouched.
"""
import re


# Only a standalone sound token. 哈哈 in 哈哈镜 is lexical and must remain.
_LAUGHTER = re.compile(r"(?<![\w])(?:哈{2,}|嘿{2,}|呵{2,}|嘻{2,})(?![\w])")
# A full Hangul token is required: 아 in 아이/아니 is a real word constituent.
# Do not collapse an arbitrary Korean ASR output to an uncertainty wildcard.
_HESITATION = re.compile(r"(?<![\w])(?:어|아|으|음|uh|um)(?![\w])", re.I)
_SPELLINGS = {"어": "呃", "으": "呃", "아": "啊", "음": "嗯", "uh": "呃", "um": "嗯"}


def hesitation_spelling(text):
    return _HESITATION.sub(lambda m: _SPELLINGS[m[0].lower()], text)


def clear_comparison(text, proposed):
    """Allow conventional foreign-ASR hesitation spelling or its omission."""
    has_foreign_hesitation = bool(_HESITATION.search(text))
    text, proposed = substantive_text(hesitation_spelling(text)), substantive_text(hesitation_spelling(proposed))
    if has_foreign_hesitation:
        # Only standalone tokens; an 啊 inside a lexical word never disappears.
        hesitation = re.compile(r'(?<![\w])[呃啊嗯](?![\w])')
        text, proposed = hesitation.sub('', text), hesitation.sub('', proposed)
    return text, proposed


def substantive_text(text):
    """Laughter need not be transcribed for the surrounding words to match."""
    return _LAUGHTER.sub("", text)


def sound_only(text):
    normalized = hesitation_spelling(text)
    return bool(normalized.strip()) and re.fullmatch(r"[\s，,。.!！?？、呃啊嗯哈嘿呵嘻咳]+", normalized) is not None
